title: Touhou Hisouten ~ Scarlet Weather Rhapsody x Streets of Rage - Japanese Street Goblin 🍺 ~ Broken Moon x The Super Threc (Remix)
description:
❝ No matter the illusion, it won't work on a drunk like me!
Drinking brings out my strongest power! ❞
ㅤ- Suika Ibuki, Touhou 12.3 Hisōtensoku (2009)

Did a mashup-mix of Broken Moon x The Super Threc (from Touhou 10.5 Hisouten ~ Scarlet Weather Rhapsody & Streets of Rage 1 respectively). Always thought SWR's version of Suika Ibuki's theme song could work well in the Streets of Rage style, so I decided to mix it with one of my favorite unused Streets of Rage tracks.

Important:
ㅤ♠ What's disabled:
ㅤㅤ - "Bonus End" (@7)
ㅤㅤ - Thunder SFX

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. C Minor (Original Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. B Minor (SMW-mix Pitch)
ㅤ3. C# Minor (Japanese Goblin Pitch)
ㅤ4. A# Minor (Custom Pitch 1)
ㅤ5. D Minor (Custom Pitch 2)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Original Echo Delay, but sacrifices SMW-Compatibility (OG Echo)ㅤ[Listening-Only]
ㅤ2. Decreased Echo Delay (LOWER Echo)ㅤ[turned on by default]

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Enables the voice clip, but sacrifices SMW-Compatibility (Voice Enabled)ㅤ[Listening-Only]
ㅤ2. Disables the voice clip & Decreases the Echo (Voice Disabled)ㅤ[turned on by default]
